families.name: KRAB zinc-finger proteins (KZFPs)
families.def: The large, rapidly evolving KRAB-ZNF family; long idiosyncratic motifs, frequently derived from transposable elements. Most ZNF### genes without a separate entry.

families.name: Q50 homeodomain (DLX/MSX/LHX-type, TAATTA)
families.def: Palindromic TAATTA read by homeodomains with glutamine at position 50, grouped by that specificity rather than by gene family: DLX1-6, MSX1-3, LHX1-9, ALX1/3/4, PRRX1/2, SHOX/SHOX2, EMX1/2, VAX1/2, EN1/2, GBX1/2, BARHL1/2, BARX1/2, UNCX, ARX, ESX1, HLX, HMX1-3, MEOX1/2, MNX1, NOTO, HESX1, ISL1/2, ISX, LBX1/2, LMX1A/1B, DBX1/2, EVX1/2, GSX1/2, TLX1-3, and the Q50 paired-like factors VSX1/2, RAX/RAX2, PHOX2A/2B, NOBOX, MIXL1, VENTX, PROP1, DRGX, BSX, OTP, SEBOX, PDX1.

families.name: Unnamed zinc-finger archetypes
families.def: Archetype motifs whose only label is the generic token ZNF, so nothing is claimed beyond the structural class. This is not one motif: it is a set of long, distinct zinc-finger matrices, many of them matching transposable-element sequence.

families.name: Other C2H2 zinc fingers
families.def: C2H2 factors and archetypes that are not KZFPs and have no dedicated entry.

families.name: RXR and its heterodimers
families.def: DR1-DR5 direct repeats of AGGTCA. RXRA/B/G, RARA/B/G, THRA/THRB, VDR, PPARA/D/G, NR1H2/3 (LXR), NR1H4 (FXR), NR1I2/I3 (PXR/CAR).

families.name: Forkhead (FOX)
families.def: RYAAAYA core. FOXA1-3, FOXB1/2, FOXC1/2, FOXD1-4, FOXE1, FOXF1/2, FOXG1, FOXH1, FOXI1, FOXJ1-3, FOXK1/2, FOXL1/2, FOXM1, FOXN1-4, FOXO1/3/4/6, FOXP1-4, FOXQ1, FOXR1/2, FOXS1.

families.name: KLF / SP (GC-box)
families.def: GC-box GGGGCGGGG and CACCC-box. KLF1-17, SP1-9.

families.name: SOX (HMG box)
families.def: AACAAT / (A/T)(A/T)CAA(A/T)G. SOX1-21, SOX30, SRY; plus SOX-OCT composite sites.

families.name: NeuroD / Atonal / ASCL
families.def: Class II neural E-box CAGATG / CAGCTG. NEUROD1/2/4/6, NEUROG1-3, ATOH1/7/8, ASCL1/2, OLIG1-3, PTF1A, FERD3L, BHLHA9/15, BHLHE22/23, MSGN1, FIGLA, NHLH1/2.

families.name: POU (octamer)
families.def: Octamer ATGCAAAT and MORE/PORE dimer sites. POU1F1, POU2F1-3, POU3F1-4, POU4F1-3, POU5F1/OCT4, POU5F1B, POU6F1/2.

families.name: ETS class I (ETS1/ERG/FLI1)
families.def: GGA(A/T) core, ACCGGAAGT. ETS1/2, ERG, FLI1, FEV, ETV1/4/5, ETV6/7, ERF, ETV3, ELK1/3/4, GABPA, SPDEF.

families.name: AP-1 (FOS/JUN)
families.def: TRE/AP-1 site TGA(C/G)TCA. FOS, FOSB, FOSL1/2, JUN, JUNB, JUND, BATF, BATF2/3, JDP2, ATF3, and FOS::JUN heterodimers.

families.name: Anterior HOX (HOX1-8)
families.def: TAAT core with PBX/MEIS cooperativity; paralogue groups 1-8: HOXA1-A7, HOXB1-B8, HOXC4-C8, HOXD1-D8.

families.name: Posterior HOX (HOX9-13, AbdB-like)
families.def: TTTTATKR / TTAT core preferred by paralogue groups 9-13: HOXA9-A13, HOXB9, HOXB13, HOXC9-C13, HOXD9-D13.

families.name: TALE homeodomain (PBX/MEIS/TGIF)
families.def: TGATTGAT and TGACAG. PBX1-4, MEIS1-3, PKNOX1/2, TGIF1/2, TGIF2LX/2LY; PBX-HOX composite sites.

families.name: T-box
families.def: AGGTGTGA half-site, palindromic in TBXT. TBX1-6, TBX10, TBX15, TBX18-21, TBXT/T, TBR1, EOMES, MGA.

families.name: Other BTB-ZF (ZBTB)
families.def: BTB-domain zinc fingers without a dedicated entry: ZBTB1-6, ZBTB11-49 and relatives. BCL6/BCL6B, HIC1/HIC2, ZBTB17, ZBTB18, ZBTB33, ZBTB7A/B/C and ZBTB48 are covered separately.

families.name: NKX
families.def: TAAGTG / CACTTAA. NKX1-1/1-2, NKX2-1 to 2-8, NKX3-1/3-2, NKX6-1 to 6-3, plus NKX-like archetypes.

families.name: PAX paired domain
families.def: Paired-domain site GTCACGC(A/T)TGA; PAX1/9, PAX2/5/8, PAX3/7, PAX4/6 (with and without the homeodomain half-site).

families.name: SCAN-domain zinc fingers (ZSCAN/ZKSCAN)
families.def: SCAN-domain C2H2 factors: ZSCAN and ZKSCAN genes, ZNF24-like SCAN factors.

families.name: IRF
families.def: ISRE/AICE, AANTGAAA repeats. IRF1-9; composite EICE (with SPI1) and AICE (with BATF).

families.name: E2F / DP
families.def: TTTSSCGC. E2F1-8, TFDP1/2.

families.name: MAF (MARE)
families.def: Maf recognition element TGCTGAC(G)TCAGCA; large MAFs (MAF, MAFA/B, NRL) and small MAFs (MAFF/G/K).

families.name: K50 homeodomain (OTX/PITX/CRX-type, TAATCC)
families.def: TAATCC/TAATCY specificity from lysine at homeodomain position 50. The true K50 set: OTX1/2, CRX, DMBX1, PITX1-3, GSC, GSC2. Paired-like factors that carry Q50 and read TAATTA are grouped with HD_Q50 instead, whatever their gene family.

families.name: CREB / ATF (CRE)
families.def: Cyclic-AMP response element TGACGTCA and its half-site. CREB1, CREM, ATF1, ATF2, ATF4, ATF7, CREB5.

families.name: GATA
families.def: WGATAA. GATA1-6, TRPS1; composite GATA-E-box with TAL1.

families.name: RFX
families.def: X-box GTTRCC(A/T)3GGYAAC. RFX1-8.

families.name: MYC / MAX / MXD
families.def: Canonical E-box CACGTG. MYC, MYCN, MAX, MXI1, MXD1-4, MNT, MGA, MLX, MLXIP, MLXIPL.

families.name: NFAT
families.def: GGAAA core; NFATC1-4 (Rel-homology) and NFAT5/TonEBP.

families.name: Divergent forkhead sites (FOXP dimeric / FHL)
families.def: Forkhead factors whose preferred site is not the canonical RYAAAYA: FOXP1-4 dimeric TGTTTAC repeats, and the alternate FHL/GACGC site used by FOXN1/N4 and bispecifically by FOXN2/N3, FOXJ2/J3.

families.name: GLI
families.def: GACCACCCA. GLI1-3, GLI4, GLIS1-3, ZIC-adjacent sites.

families.name: PRDM
families.def: PR/SET-domain zinc fingers. PRDM1/BLIMP1 (AAAG(T/C)GAAAG), PRDM4-6, PRDM9 (recombination hotspots), PRDM10/13/14/15/16.

families.name: ATF6 / CREB3 (ER stress)
families.def: ERSE / UPR elements, TGACGTGG-like. ATF6, ATF6B, CREB3, CREB3L1-L4, XBP1.

families.name: TWIST / HAND
families.def: E-box CATCTG/CAGATG bound by TWIST1/2, HAND1/2, TCF21, MESP1/2, SCX.

families.name: HES / HEY (N-box)
families.def: Class C bHLH-Orange repressors reading CACGYG (and the N box CACNAG); the CACGTG form is shared with the MYC/USF/MITF/CLOCK E-box families. HES1-7, HEY1/2, HEYL, HELT.

families.name: STAT
families.def: GAS TTCnnnGAA and ISRE-like. STAT1-4, STAT5A/B, STAT6.

families.name: C/EBP
families.def: TT(G/A)CGCAA palindrome. CEBPA/B/D/E/G, and DDIT3 (CHOP) heterodimer sites.

families.name: ETS epithelial (ELF/EHF)
families.def: AACCGGAAGT with distinct 5' preference. ELF1-5, EHF, ELF2.

families.name: HSF
families.def: Heat-shock element, inverted nGAAn repeats. HSF1/2/4/5, HSFY1/2.

families.name: ZIC
families.def: GLI-like CCTGCTGNG. ZIC1-5.

families.name: ZNF24 / ZSCAN-type promoter ZFs
families.def: SCAN-domain zinc fingers with defined promoter motifs. ZNF24, ZSCAN4, ZKSCAN1/3, ZSCAN21/22/29.

families.name: Grainyhead (GRHL)
families.def: AACCGGTT. GRHL1-3, TFCP2, TFCP2L1, UBP1.

families.name: AP-2 (TFAP2)
families.def: GCCYGCRGGC. TFAP2A-E.

families.name: MYB / MYB-like
families.def: MBS YAACKG. MYB, MYBL1, MYBL2; plus Myb/SANT archetypes (SNAPC4, MYPOP, TERF1/2 telobox).

families.name: NFE2 / NRF / BACH (ARE)
families.def: Antioxidant/electrophile response element TGACTCAGC. NFE2, NFE2L1/L2/L3, BACH1, BACH2.

families.name: Steroid receptors (GR/MR/PR/AR)
families.def: Inverted repeat of AGAACA (ARE/GRE) spaced by 3 bp. NR3C1/GR, NR3C2/MR, PGR, AR.

families.name: COUP-TF (NR2F)
families.def: DR1 AGGTCAAAGGTCA. NR2F1/2/6.

families.name: NFI (CTF/NF-1)
families.def: Palindromic TTGGC(N5)GCCAA. NFIA, NFIB, NFIC, NFIX.

families.name: MBD and CxxC readers
families.def: Methyl-CpG and unmethylated-CpG readers. MECP2, MBD1-3, CXXC1/4/5, KDM2A/B, TET1/3, DNMT1, KMT2A/B.

families.name: SIX
families.def: MEF3 element, read as TGATAC / GTATCA (the two strands of one extended site). SIX1/2/4 and SIX3/6 select the same core in vitro and differ in cofactor use rather than in sequence.

families.name: SMAD
families.def: SBE GTCT/AGAC and GC-rich SMAD motifs. SMAD1-5, SMAD9.

families.name: DMRT (DM domain)
families.def: DM element, palindromic ACAWTGTW. DMRT1-3, DMRTA1/2, DMRTB1, DMRTC2.

families.name: Chromatin regulators without a classical DBD
families.def: Motifs attributed to cofactors, readers and writers that have no sequence-specific DBD of their own: BPTF, PHF1, PHF21A, DPF1/2, MYSM1, SETBP1, TOPORS, GATAD2A, ZFPM1, ZZZ3, GLYR1, TCF20, SP140L, NAIF1, ARID1A.

families.name: HIF / ARNT
families.def: Hypoxia response element (A/G)CGTG. HIF1A, EPAS1/HIF2A, HIF3A, ARNT, ARNT2.

families.name: HNF4
families.def: DR1 with strong 5' extension. HNF4A, HNF4G, NR2C1/2 (TR2/TR4).

families.name: MEF2
families.def: AT-rich CTA(A/T)4TAG. MEF2A/B/C/D.

families.name: CUX (CUT homeodomain)
families.def: ATCGAT / ATCRAT. CUX1, CUX2, SATB1, SATB2.

families.name: ONECUT (HNF6)
families.def: TATTGATTT. ONECUT1/2/3.

families.name: TCF/LEF (HMG box)
families.def: WNT response element CTTTGWW. TCF7, TCF7L1, TCF7L2, LEF1.

families.name: SNAIL / SCRATCH
families.def: E-box CAGGTG. SNAI1-3, SCRT1/2.

families.name: Myogenic bHLH (MyoD)
families.def: Muscle E-box CAGCTG with AT-flank preference. MYOD1, MYF5, MYF6, MYOG, MSC, MYOR.

families.name: TEAD
families.def: MCAT element GGAATG. TEAD1-4.

families.name: IRX (TALE, Iroquois)
families.def: ACA-rich TALE sites. IRX1-6.

families.name: CDX / PDX / anterior gut HD
families.def: TTTATG / CTTTAT. CDX1/2/4, PDX1, and related ParaHox factors.

families.name: ETV2 / ETV6-type
families.def: ETS sites with tandem GGAA repeats favoured by ETV2 and the ETV6 repressor.

families.name: NF-kB / Rel
families.def: kB site GGGRNNYYCC. NFKB1, NFKB2, RELA, RELB, REL.

families.name: RUNX
families.def: TGTGGT core (ACCACA). RUNX1/2/3 with CBFB.

families.name: CENP-B / pogo / Tigger
families.def: CENP-B box TTCGTTGGAA and related pogo-family transposase-derived domains. CENPB, TIGD1-7, POGK, JRK, CENPBD1.

families.name: PRD-like / primate-specific (CRX-like)
families.def: Divergent paired-like homeodomains of germline and early embryo: DPRX, LEUTX, TPRX1, ARGFX, RHOXF1/2, DUX-like TPRX paralogs.

families.name: PAR bZIP (HLF/NFIL3/DBP)
families.def: Proline- and acidic-rich bZIPs binding TTATG(T/C)AA. HLF, NFIL3/E4BP4, DBP, TEF.

families.name: SAND domain (AIRE/SP100/GMEB)
families.def: GMEB1/2 (GRE-modulating), SP100, SP140, AIRE, DEAF1-like SAND factors.

families.name: EGR
families.def: GCGTGGGCG. EGR1-4, WT1.

families.name: MITF / TFE (CLEAR)
families.def: CLEAR/M-box GTCACGTGAC. MITF, TFE3, TFEB, TFEC.

families.name: YY1 / YY2
families.def: AAnATGGCggc. YY1, YY2, ZFP42/REX1.

families.name: E-proteins (TCF3/4/12)
families.def: Class I bHLH E-box CAGCTG/CACCTG heterodimer partners. TCF3/E2A, TCF4/ITF2, TCF12/HEB, TCF15, TCFL5.

families.name: p53 family
families.def: Two decamers RRRCWWGYYY. TP53, TP63, TP73.

families.name: Atypical / composite homeodomain
families.def: Homeodomains in unusual architectures: ZHX1-3, ZFHX2/3, HOMEZ, TSHZ1-3, ADNP, HDX, HMBOX1, PROX1-like, HHEX, POU-less HD archetypes.

families.name: SREBP
families.def: Sterol response element TCACNCCAC plus E-box binding. SREBF1, SREBF2.

families.name: CLOCK / BMAL1
families.def: Tandem E-boxes CACGTG of the circadian oscillator. CLOCK, ARNTL/BMAL1, NPAS2.

families.name: SPI1 / SPIB / SPIC (PU.1)
families.def: Purine-rich AGAGGAAGTG. SPI1, SPIB, SPIC; EICE composite with IRF.

families.name: ZBTB7A/B/C (LRF)
families.def: GC-rich GACCCCCCCC. ZBTB7A, ZBTB7B, ZBTB7C.

families.name: ROR
families.def: RORE: AT-rich half-site AAAGTAGGTCA. RORA, RORB, RORC.

families.name: NR2E (TLX / PNR)
families.def: AAGGTCA monomeric sites. NR2E1, NR2E3.

families.name: Thinly characterized small families
families.def: Factors with a measured motif but almost no dedicated literature: MSANTD1/3/4, DNTTIP1, FLYWCH1, FAM200B (= ZBED11), ELYS/AHCTF1, NACC2, and XPA, which is a DNA repair protein rather than a transcription factor. BANP is named in older drafts of this entry, but its only matrix is a joint Vierstra archetype filed under ZBTB_OTHER.

families.name: EBF / COE
families.def: Palindromic Olf-1/EBF site TCCCNNGGGA, read by a Rel-like DNA-binding domain with a zinc knuckle rather than by a bHLH. EBF1-4 (COE1-3).

families.name: Estrogen-related receptors
families.def: ERRE TNAAGGTCA extended half-site. ESRRA, ESRRB, ESRRG.

families.name: NR4A (NUR77/NURR1)
families.def: NBRE AAAGGTCA monomeric half-site and NurRE. NR4A1/2/3.

families.name: REV-ERB (NR1D)
families.def: RevDR2 and RORE-like sites. NR1D1, NR1D2.

families.name: CTCF
families.def: 19-bp core CCASYAGRKGGCRSYR with upstream module; the insulator/loop-anchor motif. CTCF.

families.name: Estrogen receptors
families.def: ERE: inverted AGGTCA repeat, GGTCAnnnTGACC. ESR1, ESR2.

families.name: NF-Y (CBF)
families.def: CCAAT box. NFYA, NFYB, NFYC.

families.name: BED-type zinc finger
families.def: hAT-transposase-derived BED fingers. ZBED1 (hDREF, TATCGATA), ZBED2/4/5.

families.name: HNF1
families.def: GTTAATNATTAAC palindrome. HNF1A, HNF1B.

families.name: GFI1 / GFI1B
families.def: AATC core, TAAATCAC(A/T)GC. GFI1, GFI1B.

families.name: ZNF143 / THAP11 (SBS)
families.def: SPH/SBS element ACTACAATTCCC, bound by ZNF143 and by THAP11 (Ronin) with HCFC1; also ZNF76.

families.name: OVOL (OVO-like)
families.def: CCGTTA core. OVOL1, OVOL2, OVOL3.

families.name: USF
families.def: E-box with flanking preference GTCACGTGAC. USF1, USF2, USF3.

families.name: ARID / BRIGHT
families.def: AT-rich interaction domain; ARID3A/B, ARID5A/B.

families.name: DUX / DUXA
families.def: Double homeodomain TAATCTAATCA. DUX4, DUXA, DUXB.

families.name: MAZ / PATZ1
families.def: GGGAGGG G-rich sites. MAZ, PATZ1, ZNF278-like.

families.name: HIC1 / HIC2
families.def: TGCC(A/G) HiRE sites. HIC1, HIC2.

families.name: IKZF (Ikaros)
families.def: GGGAA core Ikaros sites. IKZF1-5.

families.name: BCL11A / BCL11B
families.def: TGACCA-containing sites. BCL11A, BCL11B.

families.name: ZNF460 / ZNF317-like
families.def: Long composite KZFP motifs characterised by ChIP-exo; covers ZNF460 and the closely related ZNF317.

families.name: HINFP (MIZF)
families.def: Histone H4 promoter site GTCCGCGGTA. HINFP.

families.name: GCM (glial cells missing)
families.def: GCM box ATGCGGGT. GCM1, GCM2.

families.name: PLAG / PLAGL
families.def: GRGGC(N6-8)GGG bipartite sites. PLAG1, PLAGL1/ZAC1, PLAGL2.

families.name: OSR1 / OSR2
families.def: Odd-skipped related zinc fingers; GC-rich sites. OSR1, OSR2.

families.name: RNA-binding proteins with inferred DNA motifs
families.def: Factors whose motif comes from an RNA-binding assay or from inference, so the DNA motif should be read with caution: CPEB1, LIN28B and MBNL2. MBNL1 has no matrix in these databases.

families.name: TAL1 / LYL1 (hematopoietic)
families.def: E-box CAGCTG/CAGGTG within composite GATA-E-box elements. TAL1, TAL2, LYL1.

families.name: BHLHE40 / BHLHE41 (DEC1/2)
families.def: Class B E-box CACGTG repressors of the circadian and hypoxia programs.

families.name: BCL6 / BCL6B
families.def: STAT-like TTCCTAGAA bound by the BTB-ZF repressors BCL6, BCL6B.

families.name: DACH / SKI-family corepressors
families.def: DACH1/DACH2 (DD1 winged-helix, binds forkhead-like sites and competes with FOXM1) and the SKI/SnoN/SKOR corepressors (SKI, SKIL, SKOR1, SKOR2), whose DNA contact comes from a SAND-like motif in the Ski homology domain. Their ChIP motifs often resemble those of the homeodomain partners they are recruited by.

families.name: TFAP4 (AP-4)
families.def: Palindromic E-box CAGCTG. TFAP4.

families.name: NR5A (SF-1 / LRH-1)
families.def: SF-1 response element (T)CAAGGTCA. NR5A1, NR5A2.

families.name: NR6A1 (GCNF)
families.def: DR0 direct repeat TCAAGGTCA. NR6A1.

families.name: THAP-type zinc finger
families.def: THAP1, THAP12 and other THAP-type zinc fingers. THAP11 is covered by the ZNF143 entry, whose site it shares.

families.name: ZNF263
families.def: Long GA-rich/GGAGGA repeat motif. ZNF263.

families.name: ZNF281 / ZNF148 (ZBP-89)
families.def: GC-rich CCCCACCCC sites. ZNF281, ZNF148, ZNF219.

families.name: Transposase-derived / TE-binding zinc fingers
families.def: Zinc fingers whose motif is a transposable-element sequence (ZNF91/93 on SVA/L1, ZNF445, ZFP57 on imprinted TGCCGC, ZNF808, ZNF780A).

families.name: AHR / AHRR
families.def: Xenobiotic response element TNGCGTG. AHR, AHRR (with ARNT).

families.name: TBP / TATA
families.def: TATA box TATAWAWR. TBP, TAF1.

families.name: WT1
families.def: EGR-like GC-rich site with distinct KTS-isoform preference. WT1.

families.name: ZEB
families.def: E-box-like CACCTG bound by ZEB1/ZEB2 zinc fingers.

families.name: ZNF384 / ZNF362
families.def: AT-rich TAAAAA-type site at extracellular-matrix gene promoters, shared by the near-identical paralogues ZNF384 and ZNF362.

families.name: ZNF768
families.def: MYC-box-like TGGCAGCAGC repeat. ZNF768.

families.name: MTF1
families.def: Metal response element TGCRCNC. MTF1.

families.name: ZFP57 / imprinting
families.def: Methylated TGCCGC hexamer at imprinting control regions. ZFP57, ZNF445.

families.name: Telobox (TERF1/TERF2/ZBTB48)
families.def: Telomeric TTAGGG repeat binders. TERF1, TERF2, ZBTB48/TZAP.

families.name: SRF
families.def: CArG box CCW6GG. SRF.

families.name: CSL / RBPJ
families.def: GTGGGAA. RBPJ (SUH), plus NOTCH-dependent dimer sites.

families.name: PROX1 (Prospero)
families.def: Prospero-domain homeodomain-like factor PROX1.

families.name: Other HMG-box
families.def: HMG-box factors outside SOX and TCF/LEF: HMG20A/20B, BBX, HMGB-like archetypes.

families.name: REST (NRSF)
families.def: 21-bp RE1/NRSE TTCAGCACCACGGACAGCGCC. REST.

families.name: ZBTB33 (Kaiso)
families.def: KBS TCCTGCNA and methyl-CpG CGCG sites. ZBTB33.

families.name: MECOM / EVI1
families.def: Two-finger-cluster GATA-like and GACAAGATA sites. MECOM, PRDM16-EVI1 module.

families.name: ZFX / ZFY
families.def: CpG-island GGCCT core at promoters. ZFX, ZFY.

families.name: ZNF410
families.def: Long GC-rich site clustered at the CHD4 promoter. ZNF410.

families.name: VEZF1
families.def: CT/GC-rich sites in vascular promoters. VEZF1.

families.name: NRF1
families.def: Palindromic GCGCATGCGC at nuclear-encoded mitochondrial gene promoters. NRF1.

families.name: NPAS3 / NPAS4 / other PAS
families.def: Neuronal PAS-domain bHLH factors binding E-box variants.

families.name: Other bHLH
families.def: bHLH factors and archetypes not covered above, incl. MYRF-like and unclassified E-box archetypes.

families.name: Ndt80/PhoG-like (C11orf9/MYRF)
families.def: Ndt80-like DNA-binding domain archetypes, incl. MYRF.

families.name: HMGA (AT-hook)
families.def: AT-rich minor-groove binding. HMGA1, HMGA2.

families.name: Cold-shock domain (YBX)
families.def: Y-box CTGATTGGC. YBX1 and CSD archetypes.

families.name: Other / unclassified
families.def: Motifs whose factor has no assigned structural family here: LCOR and LCORL (psq-type HTH) and LRRFIP1. Cofactors without a DBD are in CHROMATIN; unnamed archetypes are in ZNF_UNNAMED.

families.name: CTCFL (BORIS)
families.def: CTCF-like core bound by the testis paralogue CTCFL.

families.name: INSM1 / INSM2
families.def: INSM1 and INSM2. The matrices here are GC-rich (TGTCAGGGGGCG) rather than E-box-like, and all three trace back to one compiled model, so the apparent agreement between databases is one matrix repeated.

families.name: ZBTB18 (RP58)
families.def: ZBTB18 (RP58): a C2H2 repressor reading the E-box-like site MACATCTGKM, core CATCTG/CAGATG - an E-box read by zinc fingers rather than by a bHLH.

families.name: SALL
families.def: AT-rich double zinc-finger sites. SALL1-4.

families.name: RREB1
families.def: RAS-responsive element, GC-rich. RREB1.

families.name: MYT1 / ST18 (CCHC zinc finger)
families.def: AAAGTTT core neural repressor sites. MYT1, MYT1L, ST18.

families.name: Other bZIP
